messages:
sophia: Following the postmortem I pulled together the remediation list for GPU capacity + autoscale. We need: single-line owner, one-line ETA, and one rollback action that SRE can run without approvals. Will import to the tracker at EOD.

mike: I'll take scheduler tuning and the canary harness. Plan: fairness weight sweep, conservative preemption delta, and a shadow-mode traffic run before any split. ETA: 7 business days. Rollback: flip sched_flag OFF and revert to sha @stable.

raj: I'll own quota engagement and the emergency reserved-pool workflow with Sales/Vendor. Filing the vendor form now and will collect SLAs for priority uplift. ETA: 48 hours to file. Rollback: enable reserved pool window and trigger regional failover for affected tenants.

_tess: I'll build the canary dashboard and the p99 regression alert. Also will add a short QE smoke job that runs after config flips to catch obvious regressions._

ana: small correction: my QE job will be a low-cost synthetic that exercises common prompt patterns for the top 10 tenants so signal is meaningful. I can deliver that in parallel. ETA: 4 days. Rollback: run smoke job and if failures > 2% mute canary and revert routing.

nate: I'll own the headroom runbook and oncall surge rota. I'll include exact CLI snippets to increase max_instances, trigger pre-warm, and the sales escalation play. ETA: 5 days. Rollback: console command to reduce max_instances and flip throttles for non-critical lanes.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-7321 — "PM follow-up: GPU headroom + autoscale remediations" (assignee: raj). Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INF-7321

mike: Canary design notes: 1) shadow traffic for 6h to collect KV/cache effects, 2) internal 5% split for 24h with metric gates (p99, errors), 3) widen to 15% external if stable. Metric gates: p99 delta < 12% AND error-rate delta < 0.4%. If gate fails -> immediate rollback. Will include a rollback quick-run list.

raj: Vendor note: some vendors require a 72h lead time for quota increases during high-season. If we see that window slip, Sales should activate reserved pool; I'll add that conditional to INF-7321.

_tess: Proposed PromQL for canary/baseline comparison (draft):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, tenant))
```
Alert: canary_p99 / baseline_p99 > 1.12 for 15m -> page and mute canary routing.

ana: QE smoke job outline (low-cost): 50 synthetic queries per tenant across top-10 tenants, validate latencies and output sanity checks (token count, no OOM). If >2% failures -> mark canary failed.

nate: Runbook stub (emergency headroom):
1) Increase autoscale max_instances (+20%) if quota allows (CLI: infractl autoscale set --max N).
2) Trigger pre-warmed pool (infractl pool prewarm --minutes 30).
3) Shift non-critical tenants to quantized variants (route rule: tenant.priority <= low -> model=qq-small).
4) If still saturated -> Sales reserved-pool activation + apply low-priority throttles.
I'll add contact list and exact console paths in the PR.

sophia: Consolidating for tracker:
- Quota + vendor: raj — ETA 2d — INF-7321 — rollback: enable reserved pool + region failover
- Scheduler + canary harness: mike — ETA 7bd — rollback: disable sched_flag + revert sha
- Canary dashboards + alert: tess — ETA 3d — rollback: mute canary + revert routing
- QE smoke job: ana — ETA 4d — rollback: run smoke + mute canary if failures
- Headroom runbook + rota: nate — ETA 5d — rollback: CLI steps to reduce max_instances and enable throttles

sophia: One extra ask: please append a single short note in the tracker item about recurring incident patterns you observed (e.g., time-of-day spikes, tenant-specific bursts, model warmup). That will help prioritize persistent mitigations.

mike: Observations: recurring night-batch job from tenant-X causes 3x token bursts at 03:00 UTC; scheduler preemption contributed to p99 spikes. I'll add that to my proposal.

raj: Observations: vendor quotas historically hit at month-end when partner training jobs ramp; include vendor SLA constraints in tracker.

_tess: Observations: p99 regressions often correlate with cold KV cache misses for large context windows; adding cache-warm step to canary.

ana: Observations: synthetic tests show that a small set of prompt templates account for most retries; QE will flag those patterns for the product team.

nate: I'll add a cadence: 2-week follow-ups for 6 weeks post-change to catch drift and regression patterns.

sophia: Perfect. I'll import these lines into the remediation tracker and create a brief 25-min sync next Wed to review PRs and any early canary signals. Invite incoming. :calendar: 

ops-bot: Meeting created: "PM follow-up: GPU surge actions review" Wed 11:00 — attendees: sophia, mike, raj, tess, nate, ana

sophia: Thanks everyone — please post micro-updates here as you make progress so the postmortem action list remains live. :eyes:
